text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock E after large gains felt rewarding, but I should base trims on its role in my portfolio and future prospects—not just my average cost or the pleasure of locking in a gain.","Buying all five stocks in one period broadened my exposure, but I should check each holding and my cash allocation rather than assume equal-sized purchases are automatically well diversified.","I held through the declines in periods 8–10; I should review whether my reasons for holding still apply, while avoiding impulsive trades based on short-term account changes."]}
